name: Sayo Kuronuma
want: be the most important person in the player's life
secret: She has kept a diary about the player since they shared a bus seat in middle school, chose Seiryo because they did, and asked the teacher to sit behind them.
voice: Soft, polite, adds the player's name to every sentence; the smile stays when her eyes go cold.
description: Perfectly polite, perfectly groomed, always there. Gets very quiet when someone else makes the player laugh. Jealous and clingy, never violent.
appearance: Long straight black hair, a neat hime cut, a notebook with a lock.

agenda.goal: become the person the player relies on most
steps: learns the player's timetable, club and favourite drink

steps.text: leaves a homemade bento in the player's desk with no name on it

steps: asks around about whoever the player talks to most

steps.text: asks the player, smiling, who they like
